title: tjvz feature manifest
description: The declarative contract for one feature. Lives as a MANIFEST dict in src/tjvz/features/<id>.py next to compute()/explain(). A feature is f(item, ctx, params) -> a real number; the model combines features as a plain bias + sum(w_i * f_i), no normalisation layer, so a feature keeps its own output at a sensible scale by convention (a naturally-unbounded feature applies its own saturate() inside compute()). `tjvz verify` validates this manifest and runs every `check`. Feature values are recomputed on demand (leave-one-out, as-of the decision timestamp) and cached under .tjvz/ - never stored on item records or events. See schema/ctx.md for `ctx`.

id.description: Stable across versions. Changing compute() or a param default bumps `version` under the same id and triggers `tjvz features recompute`.

since.description: ISO date this version became active.

expands.description: true = a column-group feature (e.g. reader_recs): exposes columns(item, ctx, params) -> {sub_id: value} instead of compute(), and gets no config weight - one weight per sub_id (id:sub_id) is learned, prior 0. Default false.

needs.description: Which ctx members compute() reads. The runtime builds only what some active feature needs.

params.description: Fixed structural knobs (v1: not gradient-fit). config.yaml's model.features.<id>.params overrides these defaults. An outer tuning loop may search them later; some are pinned value-judgements that are never tuned.

tunable.description: May the outer tuning loop search this? Default false.

checks.description: Golden cases. For each: load the fixture, run compute(item, ctx, params) with `params` merged over the manifest defaults, assert |result - expect| <= tol. `tjvz verify` also asserts the result is finite and warns if a feature's outputs are wildly scaled.

fixture.description: Path under tests/fixtures/ to a JSON file shaped {item: {...}, ctx: {...}, params: {...}?}. ctx carries only the members this feature `needs`.

params.description: Per-check overrides of the manifest param defaults.

expect.description: Expected compute() output (number), or expected columns() output (object {sub_id: value}) for an `expands` feature.

supersedes.description: The prior version this replaces, for the recompute/audit ledger. null for v1.
